caption_zh: 100秒事件路线、真实空间局部差距与同窗航向误差。三行依次为常规行走、大幅机身运动记录和遮挡记录。左列显示100秒完整片段，中列按固定参考中心展示1m或0.4m真实空间方框，坐标单位厘米；不同方法没有相对平移或误差倍率。方框来源分别为固定88–92秒和199.945–209.945秒数据，视窗外按空间轴裁剪。右列为同100秒航向误差，灰色仅标记实际登记遮挡。局部窗口由原参考事件和固定时长确定。
caption_en: 100-s event trajectories, physical spatial details and heading errors. Rows correspond to nominal walking, large-body-motion and obstruction records. Left: the entire100-s segment. Original samples from fixed88–92s or199.945–209.945s intervals are clipped only by the stated spatial viewport. Right: heading errors over the same100s; gray shading indicates the registered obstruction. All windows follow fixed reference-event rules.
